locator: Agent-eval guidance; non-determinism, trials, pass@k, pass^k, balanced cases, and outcome grading
summary: Anthropic distinguishes tasks, trials, graders, traces, and outcomes; recommends repeated trials because agent behavior varies; separates first-try or any-success metrics from all-trials reliability; and urges balanced cases, solvable tasks, reference solutions, and outcome inspection rather than accepting the agent's final claim.
